card.name: Linking words before patient or offender descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "as", "with", "who", "to", "were" and "-old" that come right before a description of a person or group, such as patients with a condition, criminals, drug abusers or an age.

modes.label: Linking word before a group
modes.description: A word like "as", "with", "who" or "were" that leads into crimes, addiction or offenders.
modes.example: Opioids are sought by drug abusers and people<< with>> addiction disorders and are subject to criminal diversion

modes.label: Age phrase in case reports
modes.description: The "old" in "55-year-old" or "54 year old" at the start of a patient case.
